      <-[:operatedBy]-(:Operator {name: 'Avianca'})
MATCH (aa)-[:destinedFor]->(dest:Airport)
WITH collect(DISTINCT dep) + collect(DISTINCT dest) AS airports
UNWIND airports AS airport
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT airport) AS airport_count
